dolomites.overview: Some of the world's most celebrated hiking, with limestone spires and alpine pastures reached by cable cars and gondolas that lift hikers to ridge-top trails at Seceda, Lagazuoi and Alpe di Siusi. The Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop is the classic moderate day hike, and the 75-mile Alta Via 1 is a 10-day hut-to-hut trek. Seceda, Lago di Braies and Tre Cime are crowded in summer, with timed lift slots, car restrictions or tolls. The season runs from late June to September.

madeira.overview: Madeira is famous for its levadas, a network of irrigation channels more than 1,000 miles long, with moderate hiking paths beside them through laurel forest and along cliffs, including a waterfall hike at Caldeirão Verde. The strenuous ridge hike from Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo, 6,110 ft, earns views of the island's jagged volcanic spine when the cloud lifts. Winter brings rain and cloud to the heights; spring and early autumn are best.

cape-town.overview: Table Mountain and the Cape Peninsula offer outstanding day hikes right above the city, from easy coastal and fynbos paths around Cape Point to strenuous scrambles up the mountain's sandstone cliffs. The hiking is best from March to May and from September to November, when the weather is mild.

months.6: Regular rain and low cloud obscure the views and make steep rock routes slippery.

months.12: Hot weather means early starts are needed on the exposed routes.

sedona.overview: Sedona is known for its red rock trails, where moderate canyon hikes and steep sandstone scrambles lead to expansive desert views. Cathedral Rock is a short, hands-on scramble, Devil's Bridge ends at a natural sandstone arch, and Boynton Canyon is a longer moderate hike that turns shadier toward its forested end. Summer heat requires starting at dawn.

months.3: Spring weather arrives, making the steep, strenuous scramble up Cathedral Rock ideal.
months.4: The walking is at its peak, with perfect temperatures for the exposed red rock routes.
months.6: Summer heat regularly tops 100 degrees, meaning the exposed sandstone trails are only safe for a few hours right after dawn.
months.10: Fall brings a return of perfect, cool weather for the exposed red rock trails.
months.11: The late autumn air is crisp and ideal for the steep sandstone scrambles.
